sources.title: Meet Microduck | Pollen Robotics
sources.snippet: It sees, listens, speaks, and uses its head and body to communicate. Voice is its primary medium, making it an excellent platform for developing conversational AI, experimenting with vision models, and building expressive human-robot interactions. Microduck starts from the other side of physical AI: action. How do you teach a robot to move?

sources.title: Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics Releases Small, Cute & Open-Source ...
sources.snippet: Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics has introduced Microduck, a small biped robot designed as an open development platform for experimenting with physical AI, reinforcement learning and transferring robot behaviors from simulation into real hardware.
